note: Manuel's dials (PLAN.md §5). Every game's fate is decided against these bars. As of 2026-07-28 the first four are computed from REAL live PostHog events (live.jsonl) — the seeded synthetic cohort was removed from the verdict path; metrics without enough real data are 'na' and defer to IG. ig_like_rate + ig_min_likes are the real-Instagram override — a game can be approve_scale_ig when the market loves it even if the site funnel doesn't.
